topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of immune reaction concepts
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture, recaps prior knowledge, and sets expectations for understanding the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and damage recognition by pattern recognition receptors and inflammasomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through PAMPs, DAMPs, pattern recognition receptors like TLRs and NLRs, and inflammasome signaling.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment, cell trafficking, and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the cellular events following immune activation, focusing on mediator release by sentinel cells, leukocyte extravasation, lymphatic drainage, and systemic outcomes like septic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammatory outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, rebuild damaged tissue, and manage unresolved or chronic conditions through granuloma formation.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and states the topic of the next session.
